statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Globex has reopened, but no sufficiently current independent NQ price-path source is verified at the cutoff; extreme geopolitical and rates Stress is not by itself evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Elevated forecast Tail is conditional on repeated post-reopen extension after weak or failed retracements with reinforcing cross-asset pressure; orderly repair would keep the path below blocking levels.
headline: Nasdaq Tail stays WATCH 24 at the Globex reopen
body: Globex is open for the Labor Day holiday session, while U.S. cash equities remain closed Monday. Fresh shared Finviz context from 21:46 UTC is within 90 minutes but delayed/contextual only. Gulf escalation, oil sensitivity and Friday's jobs-driven yield repricing keep Stress extreme without verified live NQ persistence evidence.

lookbackSummary: 22:00 UTC Saturday-21:00 UTC Sunday: Tail stayed in WATCH at 21-24 while NQ was closed; Stress remained 99-100 as Gulf escalation and rates risk persisted.
outlookSummary: Current Tail remains WATCH because reliable live post-reopen path evidence is not yet verified. Conditional Tail reaches 30 at 23:00 UTC only if repeated extension follows weak or failed retracements with cross-asset reinforcement; otherwise it returns to WATCH by 03:00 UTC. Labor Day liquidity keeps Stress high without automatically lifting Tail.

forecastDetail.comment: Current Tail stays WATCH because the Globex reopen is underway but no sufficiently current independent NQ path source is verified; delayed Finviz context is not treated as live structure.
Tail 30 is conditional on repeated first-hour extension after weak pullbacks with oil or yields reinforcing; meaningful gap repair would invalidate the elevated case.
Tail 29 requires second-hour directional persistence and failed retracements; deeper two-sided repair or cross-asset conflict would weaken the case.
Tail 28 requires continued near-extreme holding and failed repair; a broader two-sided range would reduce the elevated path.
Tail 26 assumes limited mean reversion into the late Asian morning; visible repair or volatility decay would return the path toward WATCH.
Tail returns to WATCH by 03:00 UTC unless the opening impulse has survived several hours without meaningful repair; Stress remains high under geopolitics, rates and holiday liquidity.
